description: Cabin watch display for nearby AIS traffic with configurable nautical-mile alert ranges and live depth.

panels.description: Projected AIS positions. Green is outside the warning range, amber is inside warning_nm, and red is inside danger_nm. Targets without meaningful SOG or observed position movement for 120 seconds use a dimmed boat-with-anchor marker. Bright cyan arrow lines show ten minutes of reported course and speed for recent moving targets. Position projection is capped at sixty seconds; targets fade as fixes age and disappear after sixty minutes. Labels prefer callsign and fall back to MMSI.

targets.query:
import "date"
import "math"
import "strings"

stationaryOnly = false
stationaryWindow = 2m
movingSpeedMps = 0.257222
movingDistanceNM = 0.01

positionHistory = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -60m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.position" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "context"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    context: r.context,
    sampleTime: r._time,
    sampleLat: r.lat,
    sampleLon: r.lon,
    self: if exists r.self then r.self else "false"
  }))

positions = positionHistory
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["sampleTime"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> rename(columns: {sampleTime: "positionTime", sampleLat: "lat", sampleLon: "lon"})

positionMotionFallback = positions
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, positionMoving: true, positionPriority: 0}))

positionMotionDetected = join(tables: {
    sample: positionHistory,
    latest: positions |> keep(columns: ["context", "positionTime", "lat", "lon"])
  }, on: ["context"])
  |> filter(fn: (r) => uint(v: r.positionTime) >= uint(v: r.sampleTime) + uint(v: 120000000000))
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["sampleTime"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
    northNM = (r.lat - r.sampleLat) * 60.0
    eastNM = (r.lon - r.sampleLon) * 60.0 * math.cos(x: r.lat * math.pi / 180.0)
    distanceNM = math.sqrt(x: northNM * northNM + eastNM * eastNM)
    return {context: r.context, positionMoving: distanceNM >= movingDistanceNM, positionPriority: 1}
  })

positionMotion = union(tables: [positionMotionFallback, positionMotionDetected])
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["positionPriority"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)

courseFallback = positions
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, cog: 0.0, motionPriority: 0}))

courseReports = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -60m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.courseOverGroundTrue" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, cog: float(v: r._value), motionPriority: 1}))

courses = union(tables: [courseFallback, courseReports])
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["motionPriority"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)

speedFallback = positions
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, sog: 0.0, sogTime: r.positionTime, hasSog: false, motionPriority: 0}))

speedReports = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -60m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.speedOverGround" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, sog: float(v: r._value), sogTime: r._time, hasSog: true, motionPriority: 1}))

speeds = union(tables: [speedFallback, speedReports])
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["motionPriority"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)

recentSpeedFallback = positions
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, speedMoving: false, motionPriority: 0}))

recentMovingSpeeds = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: date.sub(d: stationaryWindow, from: now()))
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.speedOverGround" and r._field == "value" and float(v: r._value) >= movingSpeedMps)
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, speedMoving: true, motionPriority: 1}))

recentSpeedMotion = union(tables: [recentSpeedFallback, recentMovingSpeeds])
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["motionPriority"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)

identityFallback = positions
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, callsign: "", identityPriority: 0}))

callsigns = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "communication.callsignVhf" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, callsign: string(v: r._value), identityPriority: 1}))

identities = union(tables: [identityFallback, callsigns])
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["identityPriority"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)

withCourse = join(tables: {p: positions, c: courses}, on: ["context"])
withSpeed = join(tables: {p: withCourse, s: speeds}, on: ["context"])
withPositionMotion = join(tables: {p: withSpeed, m: positionMotion}, on: ["context"])
withMotion = join(tables: {p: withPositionMotion, m: recentSpeedMotion}, on: ["context"])
withIdentity = join(tables: {p: withMotion, i: identities}, on: ["context"])

own = withSpeed
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.self == "true")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({joinKey: "own", ownLat: r.lat, ownLon: r.lon}))
  |> limit(n: 1)

targets = withIdentity
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.self != "true")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "own"}))

join(tables: {t: targets, o: own}, on: ["joinKey"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
    age = float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r.positionTime)) / 1000000000.0
    sogAge = float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r.sogTime)) / 1000000000.0
    stationary = not r.speedMoving and not r.positionMoving
    projectedAge = if age > 60.0 then 60.0 else if age < 0.0 then 0.0 else age
    projectedNM = if r.hasSog and sogAge <= 120.0 and not stationary then r.sog * projectedAge / 1852.0 else 0.0
    latitude = r.lat + projectedNM * math.cos(x: r.cog) / 60.0
    longitude = r.lon + projectedNM * math.sin(x: r.cog) / (60.0 * math.cos(x: r.ownLat * math.pi / 180.0))
    northNM = (latitude - r.ownLat) * 60.0
    eastNM = (longitude - r.ownLon) * 60.0 * math.cos(x: r.ownLat * math.pi / 180.0)
    rangeNM = math.sqrt(x: northNM * northNM + eastNM * eastNM)
    risk = if rangeNM <= float(v: ${danger_nm}) then 2.0 else if rangeNM <= float(v: ${warning_nm}) then 1.0 else 0.0
    ageBand = if age <= 180.0 then 0.0 else if age <= 900.0 then 1.0 else if age <= 1800.0 then 2.0 else 3.0
    fallbackMMSI = strings.replaceAll(v: r.context, t: "vessels.urn:mrn:imo:mmsi:", u: "")
    return {
      _time: r.positionTime,
      Latitude: latitude,
      Longitude: longitude,
      Label: if r.callsign != "" then r.callsign else fallbackMMSI,
      Course: r.cog * 180.0 / math.pi,
      SpeedKnots: r.sog * 1.9438444924,
      RangeNM: rangeNM,
      AgeMinutes: age / 60.0,
      Risk: risk,
      Stationary: stationary,
      ColorLevel: risk * 4.0 + ageBand
    }
  })
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.Stationary == stationaryOnly and r.RangeNM <= float(v: ${range_nm}))
  |> group()

import "math"

positions = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.position" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "context"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon)
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> rename(columns: {_time: "positionTime"})
  |> keep(columns: ["context", "positionTime", "lat", "lon", "self"])

courses = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -15m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.courseOverGroundTrue" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, cog: float(v: r._value)}))

speeds = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -2m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.speedOverGround" and r._field == "value")
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({context: r.context, sog: float(v: r._value)}))

withCourse = join(tables: {p: positions, c: courses}, on: ["context"])
withMotion = join(tables: {p: withCourse, s: speeds}, on: ["context"])

own = positions
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.self == "true")
  |> group()
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({joinKey: "own", ownLat: r.lat, ownLon: r.lon}))

targets = withMotion
  |> filter(fn: (r) => (not exists r.self or r.self != "true") and r.sog >= 0.257222)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with joinKey: "own"}))

vectors = join(tables: {t: targets, o: own}, on: ["joinKey"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
    age = float(v: uint(v: now()) - uint(v: r.positionTime)) / 1000000000.0
    projectedAge = if age > 60.0 then 60.0 else if age < 0.0 then 0.0 else age
    projectedNM = r.sog * projectedAge / 1852.0
    latitude = r.lat + projectedNM * math.cos(x: r.cog) / 60.0
    longitude = r.lon + projectedNM * math.sin(x: r.cog) / (60.0 * math.cos(x: r.ownLat * math.pi / 180.0))
    northNM = (latitude - r.ownLat) * 60.0
    eastNM = (longitude - r.ownLon) * 60.0 * math.cos(x: r.ownLat * math.pi / 180.0)
    return {
      context: r.context,
      positionTime: r.positionTime,
      Latitude: latitude,
      Longitude: longitude,
      ProjectionNM: r.sog * 600.0 / 1852.0,
      Course: r.cog,
      RangeNM: math.sqrt(x: northNM * northNM + eastNM * eastNM)
    }
  })
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.RangeNM <= float(v: ${range_nm}))

starts = vectors
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r.positionTime, context: r.context, Sort: 0, Latitude: r.Latitude, Longitude: r.Longitude}))

ends = vectors
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
    _time: r.positionTime,
    context: r.context,
    Sort: 1,
    Latitude: r.Latitude + r.ProjectionNM * math.cos(x: r.Course) / 60.0,
    Longitude: r.Longitude + r.ProjectionNM * math.sin(x: r.Course) / (60.0 * math.cos(x: r.Latitude * math.pi / 180.0))
  }))

union(tables: [starts, ends])
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["Sort"])

ownPosition = positions

join(tables: {p: ownPosition, c: course}, on: ["joinKey"])

import "array"
import "math"

radius = float(v: ${danger_nm})
angles = array.from(rows: [{a: 0.0}, {a: 15.0}, {a: 30.0}, {a: 45.0}, {a: 60.0}, {a: 75.0}, {a: 90.0}, {a: 105.0}, {a: 120.0}, {a: 135.0}, {a: 150.0}, {a: 165.0}, {a: 180.0}, {a: 195.0}, {a: 210.0}, {a: 225.0}, {a: 240.0}, {a: 255.0}, {a: 270.0}, {a: 285.0}, {a: 300.0}, {a: 315.0}, {a: 330.0}, {a: 345.0}, {a: 360.0}]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with k: "ring"}))

import "math"

radius = float(v: ${range_nm})
angles = array.from(rows: [{a: 0.0}, {a: 15.0}, {a: 30.0}, {a: 45.0}, {a: 60.0}, {a: 75.0}, {a: 90.0}, {a: 105.0}, {a: 120.0}, {a: 135.0}, {a: 150.0}, {a: 165.0}, {a: 180.0}, {a: 195.0}, {a: 210.0}, {a: 225.0}, {a: 240.0}, {a: 255.0}, {a: 270.0}, {a: 285.0}, {a: 300.0}, {a: 315.0}, {a: 330.0}, {a: 345.0}, {a: 360.0}]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with k: "ring"}))
own = from(bucket: "ais") |> range(start: -3m) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.position" and r.self == "true" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon")) |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value") |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon) |> group() |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true) |> limit(n: 1) |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: "ring", lat: r.lat, lon: r.lon}))

join(tables: {a: angles, o: own}, on: ["k"]) |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: now(), Sort: r.a, Latitude: r.lat + radius * math.cos(x: r.a * math.pi / 180.0) / 60.0, Longitude: r.lon + radius * math.sin(x: r.a * math.pi / 180.0) / (60.0 * math.cos(x: r.lat * math.pi / 180.0))})) |> sort(columns: ["Sort"])

panels.description: Count of AIS targets whose last position is no older than sixty minutes and falls inside the selected display range.

targets.query:
import "math"

positions = from(bucket: "ais")
  |> range(start: -60m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "navigation.position" and (r._field == "lat" or r._field == "lon"))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time", "context"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => exists r.lat and exists r.lon)
  |> group(columns: ["context"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
  |> keep(columns: ["context", "lat", "lon", "self"])

own = positions
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.self == "true")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({k: "own", ownLat: r.lat, ownLon: r.lon}))
  |> limit(n: 1)

targets = positions
  |> filter(fn: (r) => not exists r.self or r.self != "true")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with k: "own"}))

join(tables: {t: targets, o: own}, on: ["k"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => {
    northNM = (r.lat - r.ownLat) * 60.0
    eastNM = (r.lon - r.ownLon) * 60.0 * math.cos(x: r.ownLat * math.pi / 180.0)
    rangeNM = math.sqrt(x: northNM * northNM + eastNM * eastNM)
    return {_time: now(), Risk: if rangeNM <= float(v: ${range_nm}) then 1.0 else 0.0}
  })
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.Risk == 1.0)
  |> group()

A boat with an anchor has shown neither SOG above 0.5 kn nor at least 0.01 NM of position movement for 120 seconds; anchored markers render at 50% opacity and return to normal as soon as movement resumes. Bright cyan arrows show a 10-minute course vector for moving targets with recent data. Targets progressively dim after 3, 15, and 30 minutes, then disappear at 60 minutes. Labels show callsign when available and MMSI otherwise.
